title: John Hennessy and David Patterson 2017 ACM A.M. Turing Award Lecture
summary: Hennessy and Patterson's 2018 Turing Award lecture at ISCA, A New Golden Age for Computer Architecture. It covers domain-specific hardware, security, open instruction sets and agile chip development.
why: HN repeatedly recommends it as the best overview of the past, present and future of chip performance after Moore's law.

quote.text: I consistently recommend Hennessy and Patterson's Turing Award Talk[1] as a good overview of the past, present and future of chip performance.
